style: Approved I_06A variant 4: dark weathered stained glass
commonPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer. One production game chapter artwork, portrait aspect ratio 460:778, approximately 920x1556 pixels, full opaque rectangular PNG. Image 1 is the authoritative CONTENT/SCENE reference. Image 2 is the user-approved STYLE reference I_06A variant 4. Re-create the content of image 1 as newly authored stained glass in exactly the visual family of image 2. Do NOT import the battle, soldiers, comet or architecture of image 2 into an unrelated scene.
STYLE LOCK: ancient smoke-darkened fortress glass; uneven old glass with fine bubbles, scratches, grimy edges and mineral-like patina; robust oxidized dark lead following scene contours; weathered medieval grisaille painted details within individual panes; sepia, iron gray, tarnished ochre, muted moss green, dried crimson, amber luminous accents appropriate to the scene. Gritty Quake gothic craftsmanship, solemn dark fantasy. Keep broad scene forms readable, nuanced shaded glass in muted colors; avoid candy-colored jewel hues, clean flat cartoon outlines, modern vector styling, glossy CGI or an ordinary screenshot with a crack overlay. All depicted surfaces are crafted from glass, including characters, masonry and sky.
FORMAT LOCK: straight-on view of the artwork itself, fills entire rectangular canvas to all four sharp 90 degree corners, no round corners, no arch-shaped outer silhouette, no transparency, no room/window photo, no wide outer border, no caption, watermark or UI. Recompose the nearly square source gracefully into tall portrait without stretching objects. Keep main scene landmarks and perspective recognizable. No new narrative elements.
bSeriesAddition: MANDATORY: Render as a TALL portrait stained glass panel, NOT square. All surfaces must visibly consist of aged glass divided by black lead. The style transformation must be strong and unmistakable throughout. No surviving screenshot pixels or conventional 3D rendering.
promptAssembly: commonPrompt + newline + (bSeriesAddition + newline for B images) + 'SCENE ' + name + ': ' + scene

scenes.name: I_02A
scenes.scene: An exterior demonic industrial fortress courtyard beneath blood-red storm clouds and jagged black mountains. At left a twisted dead tree on a rocky ledge, ribbed bronze-black tech building at back with skull banners, two low orange glowing rune teleport pads on the ground, two squat dark biomechanical pod-like structures in foreground/right, muted mossy ground and a shallow rocky trench to the right. No soldiers or active battle.

scenes.name: I_03A
scenes.scene: A dark indoor industrial control room: dominant orange circular occult/technical schematic display at upper left behind a bulky sloped black metal console, hazy gray rectangular window/display on back wall, four amber ceiling lights casting downward amber bands, iron panel walls, yellow-black hazard edge trims, one small electrical spark at right. Tiny red remnant at left only. Maintain interior enclosure with no sky, no soldiers, no added central magical orb. Schematic should read as diagram linework rather than illegible text.

scenes.name: I_04A
scenes.scene: A tall industrial storage atrium from low viewpoint: stacked battered bronze wooden/metal crates on floor and mezzanine, large ceiling skylight with overcast snowy gray light, thin red strip lights tracing mezzanine edges, black riveted columns and grated passages, small cyan monitor in back left, small fallen green-armored figure at floor in middle distance. Large stacked crates dominant foreground right, clear vertical depth. Keep cold gray skylight, no outdoor fiery sky.

scenes.name: I_05A
scenes.scene: An empty black-stone fortress passage after a battle, floor strewn with stylized dark crimson demon remains as in source, high black masonry walls flanking long passage, overhead stone bridge and square tower ahead, immense rust-orange storm sky and craggy mountains above. No live soldiers or active combat; source has a barren aftermath atmosphere. Dark worn cobbled floor and muted red pools, no extra new creatures. Translate source gore into restrained narrative glass shapes.

scenes.name: I_07A
scenes.scene: A perilous volcanic canyon: tall dark rough rock walls, glowing orange lava river winding below and around small jagged stepping ledges, recessed small fortress facade with pointed barred doorway high in left cliff, narrow vertically staggered red illuminated strips in central cliff, distant fantastically tall jagged spires under smoky brown-gray turbulent clouds. A small brown fallen creature/object on near rock ledge. Strong vertical scale and river depth. No green soldiers, no battle bridge from style reference.

scenes.name: I_09A
scenes.scene: Volcanic boss-arena aftermath: broad dark basalt platform in lower foreground with a large slain brown horned demon and restrained dark red blood, charred leafless stump/tree right, immense suspended circular dark machinery disk at upper left with small red glowing underside, cylindrical stone pedestal below, distant orange lava waterfall spilling down cavern rock in upper right, lava beside platform, brown smoky haze. Preserve enormous overhead disk, dead demon, tree and lava fall. No alive hero or new battle.

scenes.name: I_10A
scenes.scene: The Source occult ritual chamber inside a towering black stone cavern: colossal orange circular intricate runic seal suspended centrally in upper half, intersected by a brilliant narrow vertical amber energy beam, large translucent orange cylindrical energy field with sparse runes surrounding it; jagged black stone silhouettes in foreground, small amber pointed portals on lower left and right. Reinterpret thin magical lines as luminous amber glass/painted vitreous details, central circular sigil legible and not replaced by a creature. Dark vertical enclosing cavern, no sky, no soldiers. Preserve source's ritual glyph design as closely as glass medium permits.

scenes.name: I_02B
scenes.scene: A quiet lava canyon at night, towering near-black rough rock walls, broad molten orange river across lower half, a single tall rectangular spillway framed by dark buttresses left of center pouring bright amber-orange lava into the river. Small gray-blue splash or steam at base. Tiny embers, overcast smoky gray-brown sky visible at top. No soldiers, no monsters, no bridge. Translate flowing lava into long warm irregular glass facets.

scenes.name: I_03B
scenes.scene: Long narrow industrial corridor with deep one-point perspective, heavy dark ribbed metal walls, rectangular hanging ceiling lamps with red horizontal slits, red glowing structural columns at left, amber portal schematic screen on left wall and a recessed patterned mechanical panel on right. Two fallen brown demons with restrained dark crimson pools on the floor, one near foreground center and one at vanishing point. No live characters. Retain cold dark industrial geometry and blood-red accent illumination.

scenes.name: I_04B
scenes.scene: Exterior side view of black stone fortress wall elevated above lava. Three tall cylindrical stone buttress pillars descending into the molten river at left, each topped by narrow gothic iron fire brazier. Fortress battlements across middle, square tower with slim dark gold banner at upper right, jagged mountains and red-orange storm sky, lava with dark cooled crust rafts below. No soldiers or battle. Match exact architecture and warm/cold contrast through weathered glass.

scenes.name: I_05B
scenes.scene: Dark medieval-industrial portal hall. Dominant tall rectangular portal in a rune-tiled black stone frame at center right, fiery amber vortex circling a black hollow, wide short staircase ascending to it from lower foreground. Carved dark columns at sides, red downlights on ceiling and small vertical red lights beside the portal, small gold candle stands flanking stairs. Restrained blood/demon remains on steps as source. Preserve source oblique low angle, no additional characters. Actual internal portal frame remains rectangular but image fills sharp outer corners.

scenes.name: I_06B
scenes.scene: Close low-angle view of a towering rectangular amber vortex portal, its black stone frame lined with distinct glowing orange runes, black masonry surrounding it, thick carved column at far left, red downlights overhead, small candles either side, bloody patterned steps in foreground. A fallen green-armored marine visible at lower right, with pale helmet and dark red injury. The dark portal center is surrounded by amber spiraling energy. Same room design as source, but closer view than I_05B. No standing marines or battle outside.

scenes.name: I_07B
scenes.scene: The Source's outdoor cosmic rift: low viewpoint along a pitch-black jagged rocky path/platform toward one very narrow vertical blazing amber energy beam reaching high through a huge opening in turbulent clouds. Fine amber helical rings spiral around beam, jagged floating rock island to its right at middle height, dark starry void at top, thick smoky brown/crimson clouds rimmed with fire on either side. Vertical dramatic panorama, no soldiers or buildings. Keep main single beam slender, interpret energy spirals as fine golden glass/painted vitreous arcs.

scenes.name: I_09B
scenes.scene: A sealed rectangular occult doorway in a rough dark cave wall. Thick frame made of square black stone tiles each carved with angular gray runes, inset tall panel of dark red-black organic/veined material. One small floating anatomical crimson heart with red glow at center-lower part of panel. Muted mossy cave floor with angular broken red-black floor fragments at bottom. Keep heart small relative to door, source oblique upward perspective, dark somber interior. No amber vortex or added characters. All material is stained glass including the heart.

scenes.name: I_10B
scenes.scene: A doomed planet seen from space, fills nearly entire portrait, spherical curvature prominent on left and bottom with upper right hemisphere disappearing into dark shadow. Surface muted slate blue, charcoal and weathered gray, cloud/terrain details; a dramatic branching molten amber fracture diagonally across planet from upper left toward lower right, warm rim light along lower-left edge, tiny stars in near-black background. Preserve the very recognizable planet and diagonal glowing fissure. Reinterpret entirely as ancient weathered stained-glass artwork in approved dark mineral glass style, curved lead subdivisions wrapping spherical form. Allow muted slate-blue planet colors from source, avoid making planet look like fortress masonry. No figures, no text, no planets added.

approvedExample.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create one finished rectangular stained-glass game chapter illustration, portrait aspect ratio 460:778, ideally 920x1556 pixels. Input 1 C:/Temp/interms/I_06A.png is the authoritative SCENE reference. The other inputs QWINDOW1, QWINDOW3, QWINDOW4 are STYLE/MATERIAL references only; do not copy their individual characters.
Re-create the SOURCE scene as newly authored stained glass: a violent battle on a black medieval fortress stone bridge, converging toward a central battlement wall with an amber-lit pointed gateway; green armored marines advancing and firing toward red/brown Doom demons, a floating red orb monster, tower at left and a tall gothic fire brazier to the right, serrated mountains under an immense fiery red-orange storm sky with a falling ember comet. Preserve recognizability of bridge battle, source architecture and source green-versus-red figures while composing naturally for a tall portrait panel. Make foreground marine and middle-distance battle readable, not lost in black. No text, letters, labels, watermark or UI. The image is the glass artwork itself viewed straight on, not a photograph of a window in a room. Full bleed rectangular pane with four sharp 90-degree corners, artwork fills all corners, no rounded silhouette, no arched outer contour, no black outer margins. Genuine luminous colored textured glass pieces separated by dark lead cames, designed around subject contours, rather than an ordinary painting with random cracks.
VARIANT 4 — ancient smoke-darkened fortress glass. Restrained sepia, iron gray, tarnished ochre, dried crimson and desaturated moss-green colors, warm amber light only in fire, sky fissures and gate. Uneven old glass, fine bubbles and scratches, grimy edges, robust oxidized lead, weathered medieval grisaille painting details. Broad readable scene forms with selective fine panes, haunted and solemn dark fantasy. Distinct material patina and muted saturation, keep figures readable; no shattered/missing pieces or holes.
